request_body.heading: Head of People Operations (HPO)
request_body.company_overview: Trovotech Ltd is a SEC - regulated digital asset and tokenization platform building secure, compliant, and accessible investment infrastructure for real-world assets. Our mission is to build compliant, intuitive, and scalable technology that enables the tokenization, management and trade of real-world assets, expanding access to capital and investment opportunities within emerging and global markets.

The Role: This is a strategic leadership role, not an administrative HR position.
You'll design and own hiring, onboarding, performance management, policy custodian and culture frameworks that support a fast-growing, regulated fintech.
What You'll Own: End-to-end people operations and HR strategy
Hiring and onboarding systems across technical, compliance, and growth roles
Performance, accountability, and leadership development frameworks
What We're Looking For: 7+ years HR / People Ops experience (startup, fintech, or regulated environment preferred)
Proven experience building people systems from scratch
High integrity, sound judgment, and strong leadership presence
What Success Looks Like: 6 months: Hiring and performance systems fully operational
12 months: Strong retention, engagement, and leadership depth

application.apply: Send CV + Short Note to hiring@trovotech.io
application.subject: Head of People Operations - Trovotech

2_get_all_career_roles_public.description: Get all published career roles (public endpoint, no auth required)

3_get_all_career_roles_admin.description: Get all career roles including drafts (admin endpoint, requires auth)

4_get_career_role_by_id_public.description: Get a specific career role by ID (public, only if published)

5_get_career_role_by_id_admin.description: Get a specific career role by ID (admin, includes drafts)

application.apply: Send CV + Short Note to hiring@trovotech.io
application.subject: Head of People Operations - Trovotech

8_publish_career_role.description: Publish a draft career role (changes status from draft to published)

9_enable_career_role.description: Enable a disabled career role (changes status from disabled to published)

10_disable_career_role.description: Disable a published career role (changes status from published to disabled)

backend_developer_example.heading: Back End Developer
backend_developer_example.company_overview: Trovotech Ltd is a SEC - regulated digital asset and tokenization platform building secure, compliant, and accessible investment infrastructure for real-world assets.

The Role: This is a hands on technical role, not a support or maintenance position.

As Backend Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain Trovotech's core backend systems, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and performant to handle investor transactions and asset management operations.
What You'll Own: Design, implement, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and databases
Ensure security, scalability, and reliability of backend services
Collaborate with Frontend and Blockchain developers to integrate APIs and services
What We're Looking For: 5+ years experience in backend development (Node.js, Python, Go, Java, or similar)
Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases
Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and microservices architecture
What Success Looks Like: 6 months: Reliable, secure, and maintainable backend systems fully operational
12 months: Scalable backend architecture supporting high-volume transactions and new product launches

application.apply: Send CV + Short Note (Include Portfolio/GitHub) to hiring@trovotech.io
application.subject: Backend Developer - Trovotech

product_manager_example.heading: Product Manager
product_manager_example.company_overview: Trovotech Ltd is a SEC - regulated digital asset and tokenization platform building secure, compliant, and accessible investment infrastructure for real-world assets.

The Role: This is a core product leadership role.
As Product Manager, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for key components of the Trovotech platform.
What You'll Own: Product vision, roadmap, and prioritization aligned with company strategy
Translation of business and regulatory requirements into clear product specifications
Ownership of product discovery, user research, and requirements definition
What We're Looking For: 5+ years experience as a Product Manager in fintech, financial services, or technology-driven platforms
Strong understanding of agile product development and SDLC
Experience working on regulated or compliance-sensitive products
What Success Looks Like: 6 months: Clear product roadmap in place; predictable delivery rhythm established
12 months: Measurable improvements in product adoption, user experience, and platform reliability

application.apply: Send CV + Short Note to hiring@trovotech.io
application.subject: Product Manager - Trovotech
